events.description:
The Fall Session for ACEing Autism will run from September 20th to November 8th, with clinics held every Sunday from 11 a.m. to 12 p.m.
 
This is a wonderful opportunity to earn hours by cultivating a supportive, inclusive community. You will have the chance to build relationships with the athletes and witness the impact you have on them and their families. Through your service, you will contribute to ACEing Autism's mission to help children with autism grow, develop, and benefit from social connections and fitness through affordable tennis programming.
 
Those who are interested should first fill out this quick form to ensure they receive information from ACEing Autism: https://tally.so/r/Pd2ZJQ
 
Registration Process:
Volunteers sign up through CampDoc:
https://app.campdoc.com/!/dn/login


Create / Log in to your CampDoc account
Click on Registration --> Register for upcoming session
Search for Orlando and select all the clinics you can attend *
Complete your Volunteer Profile
Ensure your background check is completed **

* Please note that they prefer volunteers to attend at least 50% of the clinics so they can provide our participants with consistency.
** A completed background check is required prior to attending all clinics. 
*** If you do not see our upcoming Fall session clinics listed, try logging out and logging back in to CampDoc.

 

Communication:


In addition to signing up on CampDoc, volunteers should join the GroupMe exclusive to this Fall session. The GroupMe provides another point of contact to reach them if you have any questions or concerns. The GroupMe is also the most efficient way to communicate last-minute notifications or complications. 
GroupMe link:
https://groupme.com/join_group/116415251/XJy0Hx9R 
 
 
 
Please fill out the attendance link once per day you attended.

events.title: Knight Hacks IX
events.description:
KNIGHT HACKS IX REGISTRATIONS ARE LIVE, ENTER THE ENCHANTED FOREST ✨🌲🐉
🗓️October 9th - 11th, 2026
📍UCF Main Campus
🔗 https://2026.knighthacks.org/
 
The Forest Is Calling
After the events of Knight Hacks VIII, the monsters emerged victorious, and Lenny lost the gem that once allowed him to transform into a mighty dragon. Now, the gem has fallen somewhere deep within the enchanted woods, spreading wild magic through the roots and shadows of the forest.
 
T.K. has vanished in the chaos, and Lenny must find them before the gem’s power grows too dangerous to control.
 
The forest is alive with secrets, and it’s up to you to step beyond the trees, follow the clues, and uncover what’s been hiding in the shadows.
 
Join The Adventure
Join us for a weekend full of hacking, networking, and adventure alongside 1,300+ hackers, builders, designers, and creators. Knight Hacks was rated UCF’s Best RSO Event with an average rating of 9.2/10, and this year, we’re going even bigger.
 
With different hacker tracks, exciting challenges, hands on workshops, 10 sponsors already confirmed, mentor support, and plenty of chances to learn something new, Knight Hacks IX is the place to bring your ideas to life.
 
Every path through the forest leads somewhere different: a new skill, a stronger team, a stranger idea, or a project you didn’t know you could build. Where yours goes is up to you!!
 
Don’t wait, register now and help Lenny find T.K. before the forest keeps its secrets forever!!!
 
Mentor & Volunteer Applications
Interested in helping guide hackers through the woods? Mentor applications and volunteer applications are also open!
Mentor Application: Mentor
Volunteer Application: Volunteer
 
Instagram Giveaway
Excited about Knight Hacks IX? We are too, so we’re running a GIVEAWAY on our Instagram! We're giving out a Wacom One Drawing Tablet!! Here’s how to enter:
 
1. Follow our Instagram account and like our Knight Hacks IX announcement post.
2. Tag 3 friends in the comments.
3. Repost the event flyer on your story and tag us @knighthacks.
 
See You In The Forest
Can’t wait to see you all in the enchanted forest ⚔️✨
 
With 💜

events.title: 4th Annual Ergathon Fundraiser (2026)
events.description:
We’re excited to announce that our biggest fundraiser of the fall semester, Ergathon, is here and the donation link is open! The event will occur on October 18 from 8am-8pm and will be livestreamed on our socials (Instagram: @centralfloridarowing | Youtube: @centralfloridarowing1707). Our goal this year is to raise $15,000, which will go directly to racing fees, coaching, equipment, and gear for our rowers, as well as other club-related expenses. The donation link is open now and we welcome and encourage any early donations if you want to get an early start! Any total milestones we hit before Ergathon will be celebrated with challenges on the day-of (milestone challenges = coaches erg⚔️). Rewards/donations collected during, or before, the stream will correlate to a punishment for whoever is currently erging. These can range anywhere from forcing the rower to sprint for an allotted distance, mandating both rowers to race against each other for 1 minute, pieing the rower in the face, or throwing water balloons!The schedule of rower-specific erg times will be released shortly before Ergathon, as will the list of challenges per donation amount. Keep an eye out if you have a specific rower you would like to support!Every dollar you donate is an INCREDIBLY big help to the team. Donations as low as $5 help us to buy replacement boat hardware, or even bring us closer to purchasing a new boat. As we are a club team, our funding from the school is very limited, and the majority of the costs of racing, practicing out of a Division 1 Facility, having great coaches, and growing our fleet of boats comes directly from our semester dues paid by the athletes combined with fundraising we do throughout the year.
Last year, all thanks to YOUR support in our 3rd annual Ergathon,  CFR was able to purchase a Hudson 8+ and TWO Vespoli 4+ shells, allowing for more members of the team to practice and race in some of the top equipment available. We also were able to acquire several new Concept2 ergs, bergs, and a new set of oars. These equipment purchases contribute directly to building our speed on the water, allowing our team to achieve better placements at national regattas like ACRA. With your incredible support, our goal this year is to continue growing our fleet size in boats and land equipment, as well as to repair or replace our coaching launches.
We are always incredibly grateful for the immense amount of support from our family members, friends, and club alumni.
GO KNIGHTS, CHARGE ON!
